description:
• Brand Introduction:

At LEVOstore, we design and build premium rolling stands for laptops, tablets, books, and monitors — helping people work, read, and create more comfortably. From professionals working at home to patients recovering in hospitals, our stands are used worldwide for their durability, flexibility, and thoughtful design. We’ve been in business since 1998 and our mission is to help people stay productive and comfortable wherever they are.

• Product Description:

Our flagship products include fully adjustable rolling stands that securely hold laptops, tablets, or books at the perfect angle and height — whether you're sitting, standing, or lying down. They’re used by remote workers, musicians, educators, hospital patients, and more. Key features include counterbalance stability, 360-degree rotation, and compatibility with most devices and cases.

• USP (Unique Selling Point):

LEVO stands offer unmatched adjustability and mobility — designed with a counterbalance system that allows users to swing the device over chairs, beds, or recliners without sacrificing stability. Our products are ideal for people with limited mobility, remote workers, or anyone seeking ergonomic convenience.

• Payment Terms:

We offer a competitive affiliate commission starting at 10% per sale. Payments are processed via PayPal (or your preferred method) and issued on a monthly basis, provided the minimum payout threshold is met.

  1. Commissions are approved the moment we ship the order.  We ship M-F from 8-3, EST.  Orders are shipped same or following day depending on when it drops into our system.   
  2. To account for our 30-day return window, commissions are held for 30 days before being finalized. Payouts are issued the last Friday of the following month.
  3. Yes, we have Customer First Attribution set up and their email address is used as the identifier for all orders going forward. This is a huge benefit, because most of our customers do not stop with one stand.  They buy them for their kids, other rooms, their second homes, etc...
  4. Commissions are 10% but we have not set growth tiers yet.  If you are an influencer, and have platforms with a large following, we will consider setting you up as a dealer with a 20% discount.

term_and_condition:
Thank you for joining our affiliate program! We're excited to have you on board. As our program continues to grow, we look forward to offering exclusive promotions, coupon codes, and additional perks for our affiliates.

Please note that affiliates earn a 20% commission on all eligible products. Refurbished models from our sales page are excluded from commission payments, as they are sold at little to no profit and are offered primarily to reduce waste and keep usable products out of landfills.
